## Summary
Greenfield build of **StockRoom**: a NestJS 11 + Prisma 7 + Postgres API with JWT auth and role-gated endpoints, an Angular 21 standalone-components SPA with fully URL-addressable routes, plus Dockerfiles and K8s manifests for the Colossus pipeline.

## Scope

### Files to modify
- `README.md` — replace `# inventory-05` stub with StockRoom setup/run/seed docs.
- `.github/workflows/colossus-deploy.yml` — **do not edit** (managed by Colossus).

### Files to create

**Root**
- `docker-compose.yml` — local Postgres 16 + api + web.
- `.gitignore`, `.dockerignore`.

**`api/` (NestJS)**
- `package.json`, `tsconfig.json`, `nest-cli.json`, `.env.example`.
- `prisma/schema.prisma` — full data model.
- `prisma/seed.ts` — idempotent upsert seed.
- `src/main.ts` — global `ValidationPipe({whitelist, transform})`, `/api` global prefix, CORS.
- `src/app.module.ts` — wires modules + `APP_GUARD` (JwtAuthGuard, then RolesGuard) + `APP_FILTER`.
- `src/prisma/prisma.module.ts`, `src/prisma/prisma.service.ts`.
- `src/auth/auth.module.ts`, `auth.service.ts`, `auth.controller.ts`, `jwt.strategy.ts`, `jwt-auth.guard.ts`, `roles.guard.ts`.
- `src/auth/decorators/public.decorator.ts`, `roles.decorator.ts`, `current-user.decorator.ts`.
- `src/auth/dto/login.dto.ts`, `signup.dto.ts`.
- `src/items/items.module.ts`, `items.service.ts`, `items.controller.ts`, `dto/create-item.dto.ts`, `dto/update-item.dto.ts`.
- `src/locations/locations.module.ts`, `locations.service.ts`, `locations.controller.ts`, `dto/create-location.dto.ts`, `dto/update-location.dto.ts`.
- `src/movements/movements.module.ts`, `movements.service.ts`, `movements.controller.ts`, `dto/create-movement.dto.ts`, `dto/query-movements.dto.ts`.
- `src/reports/reports.module.ts`, `reports.service.ts`, `reports.controller.ts`.
- `src/health/health.controller.ts`.
- `src/common/filters/prisma-exception.filter.ts` — maps P2002 → 400 validation error, P2025 → 404, P2003 → 409.
- `test/auth.e2e-spec.ts`, `test/items.e2e-spec.ts`, `test/movements.e2e-spec.ts`, `test/reports.e2e-spec.ts`.
- `Dockerfile`, `docker-entrypoint.sh`.

**`web/` (Angular)**
- `package.json`, `angular.json`, `tsconfig.json`, `tsconfig.app.json`.
- `src/index.html` (`<title>StockRoom</title>`), `src/main.ts`, `src/styles.css`.
- `src/app/app.config.ts`, `src/app/app.routes.ts`, `src/app/app.ts` + `app.html` (shell, renders "StockRoom").
- `src/app/core/models.ts`, `auth.service.ts`, `auth.interceptor.ts`, `auth.guard.ts`, `manager.guard.ts`, `api.service.ts`.
- `src/app/features/auth/login.component.ts`, `signup.component.ts`.
- `src/app/features/items/item-list.component.ts`, `item-detail.component.ts`, `item-form-modal.component.ts`.
- `src/app/features/locations/location-list.component.ts`, `location-form-modal.component.ts`.
- `src/app/features/movements/movement-new.component.ts`, `movement-audit.component.ts`.
- `src/app/features/reports/low-stock.component.ts`.
- `src/app/features/errors/forbidden.component.ts`.
- `nginx.conf`, `Dockerfile`.

**`k8s/`**
- `namespace.yaml`, `postgres.yaml`, `api.yaml`, `web.yaml`, `ingress.yaml`, `secrets.example.yaml`.

### Dependencies
- **api**: `@nestjs/{common,core,platform-express,config,jwt,passport}@^11`, `passport`, `passport-jwt`, `prisma`/`@prisma/client` **pinned `7.10.0`**, `bcrypt`, `class-validator`, `class-transformer`; dev: `typescript`, `jest`, `supertest`, `ts-node`.
- **web**: `@angular/{core,common,router,forms,platform-browser}@^21` (LTS), `rxjs`, `zone.js`; dev: `@angular/cli@^21`, `@angular/build`.
- **Infra**: `postgres:16-alpine`, `node:22-alpine`, `nginx:1.27-alpine`.

### Assumptions
- **Stack** taken verbatim from spec `## Non-functional`. **Angular 21 LTS** (not 22) and **NestJS 11** (not the 8-day-old v12 ESM rework) chosen for build-toolchain reliability; **Prisma pinned to `7.10.0`** because `prisma@latest` now resolves to 8.x.
- Auth model = **`full_auth`** (spec has no `## Auth` section → legacy default; clerk/manager are non-admin authenticated actors). Login + signup + logout + guards on all non-public routes. Public: `/login`, `/signup`, `/api/health`, `/api/health/deep`, `/api/auth/login`, `/api/auth/signup`.
- "First signup becomes admin" maps to `role=manager`; since seed already creates `manager@demo`, all real signups become `clerk`.
- Duplicate SKU returns **400** with a field-scoped error body (spec says "validation error", not "conflict"); over-draw returns **400**.
- Low stock = `totalQty <= reorderAt` (spec: reorderAt 10, on-hand 7 → listed; on-hand 40 → not).
- Item/Location `DELETE` is blocked (409) when movements reference them, preserving the audit log.
- JWT: HS256, 12h expiry, `Authorization: Bearer`, stored in `localStorage`. Logout is client-side token discard.
- Seed locations are named `Zone A`/`Zone B`/`Zone C` (matching scenario text) with `zone` = `A`/`B`/`C`.
- Seed runs from the api entrypoint (idempotent `upsert`), not a separate K8s Job.

## Implementation Plan

### Step 1: Repo scaffold + local compose
**Files:** `docker-compose.yml`, `.gitignore`, `.dockerignore`, `README.md`
**Change:** Postgres 16 service (`stockroom` db), api on `:3000`, web on `:4200`. `DATABASE_URL=postgresql://stockroom:stockroom@db:5432/stockroom`.

### Step 2: Prisma schema
**File:** `api/prisma/schema.prisma`
**Change:** `enum Role { clerk manager }`, `enum MovementType { IN OUT TRANSFER }`.
- `User(id cuid, email @unique, passwordHash, role Role @default(clerk), createdAt)`
- `Item(id, sku @unique, name, description String?, unit, reorderAt Int @default(0), createdAt)`
- `Location(id, name @unique, zone, createdAt)`
- `StockLevel(id, itemId, locationId, qty Int @default(0))` + `@@unique([itemId, locationId])` + index on `itemId`
- `Movement(id, type, itemId, fromLocId String?, toLocId String?, qty Int, note String?, userId, createdAt @default(now()))` + `@@index([itemId])`, `@@index([createdAt])`
Relations use named FKs (`fromLoc`/`toLoc` both → `Location`, `onDelete: Restrict`). Generate initial migration `init`.

### Step 3: Prisma service + exception filter
**Files:** `api/src/prisma/prisma.service.ts`, `api/src/common/filters/prisma-exception.filter.ts`
**Change:** `PrismaService extends PrismaClient implements OnModuleInit`. Filter catches `PrismaClientKnownRequestError`: `P2002` → `400 {message:'Validation failed', errors:[{field: meta.target[0], message:'must be unique'}]}`; `P2025` → 404; `P2003` → 409.

### Step 4: Auth module
**Files:** `api/src/auth/*`
**Change:**
- `AuthService.validate(email, password)` → `bcrypt.compare`; `login()` → `{ accessToken, user:{id,email,role} }` with payload `{sub, email, role}`.
- `signup(dto)` → hash (10 rounds); role = `manager` if `user.count() === 0` else `clerk`.
- `JwtStrategy` reads `JWT_SECRET` from `ConfigService`; `validate(payload)` returns `{id: payload.sub, email, role}`.
- `JwtAuthGuard extends AuthGuard('jwt')` — skips when `@Public()` reflector metadata present; otherwise **401**.
- `RolesGuard` — reads `@Roles(...)`; returns **403** on mismatch. Registered *after* JwtAuthGuard in `APP_GUARD` so unauthenticated → 401, wrong-role → 403.
- Controller: `POST /api/auth/login`, `POST /api/auth/signup` (both `@Public()`), `GET /api/auth/me`.

### Step 5: Items module
**Files:** `api/src/items/*`
**Change:**
- `GET /api/items?q=` — fetch items + one `stockLevel.groupBy({by:['itemId'], _sum:{qty:true}})`; merge into `totalQty`, **defaulting missing itemIds to 0**. Returns `{id,sku,name,unit,reorderAt,totalQty}`.
- `GET /api/items/:id` — item + `stockLevels` with `include:{location:true}`, `totalQty` = sum of the breakdown (guarantees the spec's "sum equals total" invariant by construction).
- `POST`/`PATCH`/`DELETE` — `@Roles('manager')`. `CreateItemDto`: `sku` `@IsString() @IsNotEmpty()`, `name`, `unit`, `description?`, `reorderAt` `@IsInt() @Min(0)`. Duplicate SKU surfaces via P2002 → 400. `DELETE` pre-checks `movement.count({where:{itemId}})` → 409 if non-zero.

### Step 6: Locations module
**Files:** `api/src/locations/*`
**Change:** `GET /api/locations` (any authenticated user — clerks need it in the movement form); `POST`/`PATCH`/`DELETE` `@Roles('manager')`. Delete blocked when referenced by a movement or a non-zero stock level.

### Step 7: Movements — atomic balance updates
**File:** `api/src/movements/movements.service.ts`
**Change:** `create(dto, user)` inside `prisma.$transaction(async tx => { ... })`:
- Validate shape per type: `IN` requires `toLocId` and rejects `fromLocId`; `OUT` requires `fromLocId`; `TRANSFER` requires both and `fromLocId !== toLocId`. `qty` `@IsInt() @Min(1)`.
- **Debit** (`OUT`/`TRANSFER`): `tx.stockLevel.updateMany({ where:{itemId, locationId: fromLocId, qty:{gte: qty}}, data:{qty:{decrement: qty}} })`. If `count === 0` → `throw new BadRequestException('Insufficient stock at source location')`. The conditional predicate makes the check race-free — no read-then-write.
- **Credit** (`IN`/`TRANSFER`): `tx.stockLevel.upsert({ where:{itemId_locationId:{itemId, locationId: toLocId}}, create:{itemId, locationId: toLocId, qty}, update:{qty:{increment: qty}} })`.
- `tx.movement.create({data:{...dto, userId: user.id}})` last. Any throw rolls back the balance, satisfying "stored balance remains 5".
- `GET /api/movements` `@Roles('manager')` — filters `itemId`, `type`, `from`/`to` (`@IsDateString`, applied as `createdAt: {gte, lte}`), paginated (`page`, `pageSize` default 50), `orderBy: {createdAt:'desc'}`, `include:{item:true, user:{select:{email}}, fromLoc:true, toLoc:true}`. Returns `{data, total, page, pageSize}`.

### Step 8: Low-stock report
**File:** `api/src/reports/reports.service.ts`
**Change:** `GET /api/reports/low-stock` `@Roles('manager')`. Load all items + the `groupBy` sums, map missing sums to `0`, filter `totalQty <= reorderAt`, sort by `totalQty - reorderAt` ascending. Returns `{id,sku,name,unit,reorderAt,totalQty}`.

### Step 9: Health endpoints
**File:** `api/src/health/health.controller.ts`
**Change:** `@Public() GET /api/health` → `{status:'ok'}` (no DB). `@Public() GET /api/health/deep` → `SELECT 1` via `$queryRaw`; 503 on failure.

### Step 10: Seed
**File:** `api/prisma/seed.ts`
**Change:** Idempotent `upsert` by unique key — `manager@demo`/`clerk@demo` (both `Demo1234!`, bcrypt); 3 locations (`Zone A`/`Zone B`/`Zone C`); 8 items with varied `reorderAt`; starting `StockLevel` rows spread across zones so the item list, per-location breakdown and low-stock report all have data on first load (at least one item seeded at or below its threshold, several comfortably above).

### Step 11: Angular shell, config, routing
**Files:** `web/src/app/app.config.ts`, `app.routes.ts`, `app.ts`/`app.html`, `src/index.html`
**Change:** `provideRouter(routes, withComponentInputBinding())`, `provideHttpClient(withInterceptors([authInterceptor]))`. Shell renders a persistent header containing the literal text **`StockRoom`** — present on `/login` too, since that is what an unauthenticated `/` resolves to and what the smoke oracle reads. Nav links hidden by role via `authService.isManager()` signal.

Routes (every navigable state addressable; each carries `data.flow`):

| path | guard | `data.flow` | query params |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/login` | public | `auth.login` | `returnUrl` |
| `/signup` | public | `auth.signup` | — |
| `/` → redirect `/items` | — | — | — |
| `/items` | auth | `items.list` | `q`, `sort`, `modal=new-item` |
| `/items/:id` | auth | `items.detail` | `tab=stock\|movements`, `modal=edit-item` |
| `/locations` | auth | `locations.list` | `modal=new-location\|edit-location`, `id` |
| `/movements/new` | auth | `movements.new` | `itemId`, `type` |
| `/movements` | manager | `movements.audit` | `itemId`, `type`, `from`, `to`, `page` |
| `/reports/low-stock` | manager | `reports.lowStock` | — |
| `/403` | auth | `error.forbidden` | — |
| `**` → redirect `/items` | — | — | — |

All modals are `?modal=` driven and restored from the URL on load; all list filters are two-way bound to query params via `router.navigate([], {queryParams, queryParamsHandling:'merge'})`.

### Step 12: Angular auth plumbing
**Files:** `web/src/app/core/*`
**Change:** `AuthService` with `token`/`user` signals hydrated from `localStorage`; `login()`, `signup()`, `logout()` (clears storage → `/login`). `authInterceptor` attaches `Authorization: Bearer` and, on **401**, clears state and redirects to `/login?returnUrl=<current>`; on **403** routes to `/403`. `authGuard`/`managerGuard` are `CanActivateFn`s.

### Step 13: Feature components
**Files:** `web/src/app/features/**`
**Change:**
- **Login/Signup** — reactive forms; login card headline includes "StockRoom"; honours `returnUrl`.
- **Item list** — table of sku / name / unit / reorderAt / totalQty; row → detail; manager-only "New item" opens `?modal=new-item`; low-stock rows visually flagged.
- **Item detail** — header fields + `?tab=stock` per-location breakdown table with a total row, `?tab=movements` for that item's history.
- **Location list** — name/zone table, manager-only create/edit modals.
- **Movement new** — item select, type select (IN/OUT/TRANSFER), from/to location selects shown conditionally by type, qty, note. Renders the API's 400 message inline on insufficient stock.
- **Movement audit** (manager) — filter bar (item, type, date range) bound to query params; columns: who / item / type / qty / from → to / timestamp; pagination.
- **Low stock** (manager) — sku, name, on-hand, reorderAt, shortfall.

### Step 14: Dockerfiles
**Files:** `api/Dockerfile`, `api/docker-entrypoint.sh`, `web/Dockerfile`, `web/nginx.conf`
**Change:**
- **api**: `node:22-alpine` builder → `npm ci`, `npx prisma generate`, `npm run build`; runtime stage copies `dist/`, `node_modules/`, `prisma/`. Entrypoint: `npx prisma migrate deploy && npx ts-node prisma/seed.ts && node dist/main.js`.
- **web**: builder runs `npm ci && npx ng build`; runtime `COPY --from=build /app/dist/web/browser /usr/share/nginx/html` — **verify the emitted path matches `angular.json`'s `outputPath` before finalising**; Angular 21 nests the browser bundle under `browser/`, and a wrong `COPY` yields a 403/blank page that no source change can fix.
- `nginx.conf`: `try_files $uri $uri/ /index.html;` for SPA deep links (required — `/items/:id` 404s without it) and `location /api { proxy_pass http://stockroom-api:3000; }`.

### Step 15: K8s manifests
**Files:** `k8s/*.yaml`
**Change:** `postgres` Deployment + PVC + ClusterIP Service; `stockroom-api` Deployment (env from Secret: `DATABASE_URL`, `JWT_SECRET`; liveness `/api/health`, readiness `/api/health/deep`) + Service `:3000`; `stockroom-web` Deployment + Service `:80`; Ingress `/` → web, `/api` → api (same host, so no CORS in prod).

## Testing Strategy
- **e2e (`api/test`, Jest + supertest against a throwaway Postgres):**
  - 401 on every data endpoint without a token; 403 for clerk on `POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/items` and `/api/locations`, and on `GET /api/movements` and `/api/reports/low-stock`.
  - Duplicate `SKU-001` → 400, and `item.count()` unchanged.
  - IN 50 into Zone A → level 50; OUT 20 → 30; TRANSFER 10 A→B → A=20, B=10 **and total unchanged**; OUT 10 against 5 on hand → 400 **and level still 5**.
  - reorderAt 10 / 12 on hand → OUT 5 → appears in low-stock; reorderAt 10 / 40 on hand → absent. Item with zero stock rows appears.
  - Audit log entries expose user email, item, type, qty, timestamp; filtering by `itemId` and by `from`/`to` narrows correctly.
- **Frontend unit:** `authGuard` redirects when unauthenticated; `managerGuard` sends a clerk to `/403`; interceptor attaches the header.
- **Smoke:** load `/` unauthenticated and assert the rendered text contains `StockRoom` (mirrors `platform/scripts/soak_smoke.py`); then log in as both seeded accounts and walk each route in the Step 11 table to confirm deep links resolve.
- **Deploy check:** `docker compose up --build`, then `curl /api/health/deep`, load `/`, and hard-refresh `/items/<id>` to prove the nginx SPA fallback.

## Risks
- **SMOKE_MARKER is the highest-risk item.** `/` redirects to `/login`; if "StockRoom" lives only in an authenticated dashboard, the Playwright oracle fails despite a correct app. The brand must be in the shell that renders on the login view.
- **Angular output path** (`dist/web/browser`) mismatching the Dockerfile `COPY` is the most likely deploy-chain break — verify against `angular.json` rather than assuming.
- **Concurrency:** the guarded `updateMany` is essential; a read-check-then-write would allow two simultaneous OUTs to drive a balance negative and silently violate the spec.
- **Version churn:** `prisma@latest` resolves to 8.x — the pin to `7.10.0` must be exact in `package.json`, not a caret range.
- **Seed on every boot:** must be strictly `upsert`-based; a `create`-based seed crash-loops the api pod on restart.
- **`bcrypt`** is a native module — if `npm ci` fails on alpine, swap to `bcryptjs` (drop-in API) rather than adding build toolchain layers.
